why:
The finding is real; I could not refute it. In book-2.json, the 經 of stable 三·一 (rendered 一·五, 「成，一辞于一步不然而次步然也」…「凡辞每步定然否」) and of stable 一·四 (rendered 一·六, 「凡一辞跨一步之成与毁」) use the name 辞. Its only definition is in stable 一·十三 (rendered 一·十九, 「辞，于一状可言其然否者也，不必定然否」). None of the 篇一 經 before them use 辞, and neither 條 gives a pointer to the definition. That is different from the book's other forward uses: 一·一 points to ⟦四·一⟧ for 取、与, and 一·四 points to ⟦二·三⟧、⟦二·四⟧、⟦三·十四⟧ for 结、解、持、化. The 凡例 exception covers only the 凡例's own 經 (C16 intro: 「凡例之經只用逻辑之名，及先用而后定于篇一之状、步、宇、辞、观」). No round-3 or round-4 edit already moves the definition.

Moving the definition to stable 一·二 (rendered 一·三) works. There it rests only on 状, defined just before it in the same 經, and on 然否 and 定然否 (凡·三, 凡·五). It also matches the Lean: `Frame.realized : S → C → Prop` is Prop-valued, so 「不必定然否」 holds, and `ComesToBe`/`CeasesToBe` take `p : Nat → Prop`, a 辞 read at each step's 状. The reviewer's find occurs exactly once in that body, and once in the whole book.

These follow-ups are not part of this edit:
(1) The companion finding removes 「辞，于一状可言其然否者也，不必定然否。」 from stable 一·十三, so 辞 is not defined twice.
(2) In the C16 intro, 「状、步、宇、辞、观（⟦一·二⟧、⟦一·九⟧、⟦一·十三⟧、⟦一·十四⟧）」 should become 「状、步、辞、宇、观（⟦一·二⟧、⟦一·九⟧、⟦一·十四⟧）」. That intro is the only reference that points at ⟦一·十三⟧ for 辞; the references in 一·十四 and 八·十九 point at it for 系辞.
(3) The title of stable 一·二 can become 「状、动、步、辞、象与读」, since it already defines 象 and 读. In the C01 intro, 「状、动、步与象、读」 and 「次说系辞与辞」 can follow the move.
